reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering preserves and drinks, a journal scrap, a music ring, kale, kyanite, large eggs and milk, and largemouth bass were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover item context, established cross-asset names, crop timing, object gender, the flavored-item placeholder, and brand preservation; both found no remaining objective issue.

JojaCola_Name.preservationReason: Joja Cola is the established in-world brand name used consistently across the Romanian package.

JojaCola_Description.source: The flagship product of Joja corporation.

JournalScrap_Description.source: A damp tattered page torn from an old journal...
JournalScrap_Description.translation: O pagină umedă și zdrențuită, ruptă dintr-un jurnal vechi...

JukeboxRing_Description.source: Plays a random assortment of music you've heard.
JukeboxRing_Description.translation: Redă o selecție aleatorie de melodii pe care le-ai auzit.

Kale_Description.source: The waxy leaves are great in soups and stir fries.
Kale_Description.translation: Frunzele cerate sunt excelente în supe și mâncăruri sotate.

KaleSeeds_Description.source: Plant these in the spring. Takes 6 days to mature. Harvest with the scythe.
KaleSeeds_Description.translation: Plantează-le primăvara. Ajung la maturitate în 6 zile. Recoltează-le cu coasa.

Kyanite_Description.source: The geometric faces are as smooth as glass.
Kyanite_Description.translation: Fețele geometrice sunt netede ca sticla.

LargeBrownEgg_Description.source: It's an uncommonly large brown egg!
LargeBrownEgg_Description.translation: Este un ou maro neobișnuit de mare!

LargeMilk_Description.source: A large jug of cow's milk.
LargeMilk_Description.translation: Un bidon mare cu lapte de vacă.

LargemouthBass_Description.source: A popular fish that lives in lakes.
LargemouthBass_Description.translation: Un pește popular care trăiește în lacuri.

LargeWhiteEgg_Description.source: It's an uncommonly large white egg!
LargeWhiteEgg_Description.translation: Este un ou alb neobișnuit de mare!
